translations.translatedText: # Saturday 25.9.2021 (radio)
Petteri Orpo. Elderly people's medicines. A police officer was shot in Hämeenlinna. German elections.
## Petteri Orpo

![The chair of the National Coalition, Petteri Orpo, visited Yle's Ykkösaamu on 25 September.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5000,h_2813,x_0,y_227/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-858306614eced44feb3/1641564540)
Open image viewer
The chair of the National Coalition, Petteri Orpo, visited Yle's Ykkösaamu on 25 September. Photo: Silja Viitala / Yle
The chair of the National Coalition, Petteri Orpo, criticises the government. The National Coalition is an opposition party.

Petteri Orpo says that Finland's economic growth is not the government's merit. In Orpo's view the economic growth was brought about by the previous government. Petteri Orpo was himself part of the previous government.
Petteri Orpo says that the current government has taken on too much debt. In Petteri Orpo's view, the government is also wasting state money.

The National Coalition says that, for example, housing benefit is paid to people too much. The National Coalition wants unemployment benefits to be worse in the future than now. The National Coalition also wants wages and working conditions to be agreed in companies.
## Medicines for elderly people
![An elderly person's hands folded on a table.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5616,h_3159,x_0,y_70/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-76452660086cc6def45/1669188428)
Open image viewer
The most commonly used medicines among older people have not changed much in recent years. Photo: Mostphotos
Many old people take several medicines at the same time.
The Finnish Medicines Agency Fimea says that 13 per cent of people over 75 in Finland take 10 or more medicines. Almost all old people have at least 1 medicine.
When a doctor prescribes a new medicine for an elderly person, the doctor does not always look at the elderly person's old medicines. This is what Fimea says.
Doctors also prescribe medicines to people over 75 that elderly people should avoid.
## A police officer was shot in Hämeenlinna
![Police alarm light](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_1920,h_1080,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-82272260cc5460818ef/1624366003)
Open image viewer
A police officer was wounded while on duty in Hämeenlinna late on Friday evening. The police officer has left hospital and is not in danger of his life. Photo: Timo Nykyri / Yle
A police officer was shot at in Hämeenlinna last night. The police officer has already left hospital.
The police also used a weapon in Hämeenlinna. A dangerous person did not stop until the police shot. The incident was in the yard of an apartment block in Hämeenlinna.
Police were shot at the previous time a month ago. A man shot at police in Ruskko in Varsinais-Suomi. 1 police officer was wounded. The shooter died when the police shot him.
## German elections

![Two people stand next to each other at a speaker's podium. One of them greets a man standing nearby with his hand.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5360,h_3015,x_0,y_352/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-85632861494c8acef2a/1632193794)
Open image viewer
Social Democrat Olaf Scholz, Green Annalena Baerbock and Christian Democrat Armin Laschet are competing for the post of German chancellor. Photo: EPA-EFE/All Over Press
Important elections are held in Germany on Sunday. In the elections the German parliament is chosen.
Germany's federal chancellor, that is, the head of government, will change after the election. The current federal chancellor, Angela Merkel, is not continuing in the post.

Olaf Scholz, a Social Democrat, and Armin Laschet, a Christian Democrat, are in a tight race for the post of federal chancellor. In opinion polls the support of the Social Democrats and Christian Democrats is level.
